content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":true,"reason":"Bumble runs consumer dating and social networking apps monetized through premium subscriptions and in-app features, closely matching Grindr's model."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Digital Turbine sells mobile ad tech, monetization software and app preloads to developers and carriers, not a consumer social app."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"DoubleVerify sells ad measurement and verification software to advertisers and agencies, with no consumer app or dating business."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"IAC is a publisher of lifestyle, health and finance content earning ad and affiliate revenue, not a social networking app."},{"label":"C5","good":true,"reason":"Match Group operates online dating apps selling premium memberships to individual adults, the same core business as Grindr."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Taboola operates native advertising and content recommendation technology for publishers and advertisers, not a consumer social app."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Arena Group is a sports and lifestyle publisher selling ads, sponsored content and affiliate commerce, not a social networking app."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"The Trade Desk sells programmatic ad buying software to agencies and brands, a B2B adtech business unlike Grindr's consumer app."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Viant sells programmatic ad buying software and managed campaigns to advertisers and agencies, a B2B adtech business."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Ziff Davis is a diversified digital media, cybersecurity and marketing software company, with no dating or social networking app focus."}]}
